Race Wars
%message%
Your race against another: the six races are drawn into pairs, each an army of at least %size% (its players, the rest fake players of that race). You fight for the race of the class you play when registration closes, a subclass included.
There is no coming back: the dead stay dead, and a race is out once its last fighter falls. No winner after %monster_time% minutes: %monsters% monsters come for everyone, Silent Move and Hide or not. %hard_limit% minutes later the race with the most fighters alive wins.
A race that wins early waits for the others and sees how their matches go. The three winning races meet in a final, a deathmatch: everyone for themselves, your own race too. Each player of the race of the last one standing gets %reward%, each player of the other two %lose_reward%. Every kill is a PvP.
Brackets: %brackets%
Registration closes in %time%. Registered: %count% (%race_count% %race% in your bracket).
